cues.text: Outside the dorm, you sit on the front steps with Koromaru beside you. The woman walks up to you both, bends down and pets him.
You sit on the steps with a tray of takoyaki beside you, while Koromaru eats from his own tray on the ground.
A dog walks up and stops a short way off.
Koromaru sits back from his tray, and the other dog comes over, lies down and eats from it.
